## System-Specific Rules (Mandatory)

#### Correctness
Is the logic correct? Are there missing boundary conditions?
Are exceptions handled properly?
Is it thread-safe in concurrent scenarios?

#### Security
Are there security vulnerabilities such as SQL injection or XSS?
Is sensitive information handled correctly?
Is permission validation complete?

#### Performance
Are there obvious performance issues (e.g., N+1 queries, unnecessary loops)?
Are resources properly released?

#### Maintainability
Is the code clear and easy to understand?
Do names accurately express intent?
Does it follow the project’s existing code style and architecture patterns?

#### Test Coverage
Do critical logic paths have corresponding test cases?
Do test cases cover boundary conditions?

---

## User-Specific Rules (Mandatory)

Read AGENTS.md and the confirmed requirement and acceptance records for this task. Review state transitions, idempotency, event ordering, crash/reconnect recovery, entity/artifact associations, and workdir/session/test-resource isolation. Record applicability, concrete evidence, and requirement gaps; do not invent product semantics. Inspect tests as well as implementation, callers and deletion effects. Check module boundaries, dependency direction, error handling, migration/compatibility, maintainability and confirmed extension needs; avoid speculative abstractions. Apply language/framework builtins only when they fit the actual project. Review requires an independent context; keep evidence and false-positive rationale. File coverage is not semantic or test coverage.
